spike-syntax-highlighting.description: Phase 0.5, Spike B (throwaway): verify the KSyntaxHighlighting KF6 port builds on all target triplets before Phase 8 depends on it. Not enabled by default; CI's spike job passes -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_FEATURES=spike-syntax-highlighting. NOTE: the correct vcpkg port name is "syntax-highlighting", not "ksyntaxhighlighting"/"kf6syntaxhighlighting" (verified against the pinned builtin-baseline commit — see roadmap §6.2).
